meta.description: Registry for bounded long-horizon selection drift and recursive directional-persistence behavior in Phase 3.

selection_drift_horizon_entries.name: Selection Drift Horizon Bounds
selection_drift_horizon_entries.purpose: Represent bounded long-horizon selection drift and recursive directional-persistence behavior across continuation systems.

selection_drift_horizon_conditions.name: long_horizon_orientation_drift_remains_defined
selection_drift_horizon_conditions.description: Formal support for evaluating orientation frame variance over extended recursive sequences.

selection_drift_horizon_conditions.name: directional_persistence_behavior_remains_detectable
selection_drift_horizon_conditions.description: The system must maintain metrics for identifying stable directional trends in process continuation.

selection_drift_horizon_conditions.name: recursive_selection_updates_remain_admissible
selection_drift_horizon_conditions.description: Every step in the long-horizon selection sequence must satisfy current process windows.

selection_drift_horizon_conditions.name: orientation_bias_transport_does_not_force_global_minimization
selection_drift_horizon_conditions.description: Nonlocal propagation of frame bias does not imply convergence to a globally optimal directional state.

selection_drift_horizon_conditions.name: window_sensitive_horizon_drift_remains_bounded
selection_drift_horizon_conditions.description: The influence of admissibility window dynamics on long-term drift must stay within stability thresholds.

selection_drift_horizon_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_horizon_witness
selection_drift_horizon_conditions.description: Pruning at long horizons must not eliminate all possible directional persistence paths.

selection_drift_horizon_conditions.name: recursive_horizon_instability_remains_classifiable
selection_drift_horizon_conditions.description: Breakdown in long-term directional persistence must map to registered transition or stability classes.

selection_drift_horizon_conditions.name: selection_drift_instability_remains_detectable
selection_drift_horizon_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register the breakdown of long-horizon drift bounds.
